request.initial_prompt: "I am dreaming--I am getting out of bed," she heard her own voice say; and then, as she stood up in the midst of it all, turning slowly from side to side--"I am dreaming it stays--real! I'm dreaming it Feels real. It's bewitched--or I'm bewitched. I only Think I see it all." Her words began to hurry themselves. "If I can only keep on thinking it," she cried, "I don't care! I don't care!"
request.hotwords: I, I'm, Feels, It's, Think, If
